description: Get one module's source (files) plus install instructions: write each file under src/modules/{id}/, install its dependencies, and register it in src/modules.ts. The project needs the base first (get_host_scaffold). Large modules come in PAGES: the answer has nextCursor while files remain — call again with the same id and cursor=nextCursor until nextCursor is absent. Read-only; takes no title_id.

cursor.description: Index of the first file to return (from nextCursor). Default 0.

id.description: Module id from list_modules, e.g. store or board-game.

name: get_module
title: Get module source
